title: PlanFailed
description: Immutable event emitted by the orchestrator when a plan step fails unrecoverably. Topic: conversation-events. Producer: orchestrator.ts.

conversationId.description: Unique identifier for the conversation (partition key)

reason.description: Human-readable description of why the plan failed

failedTool.description: Name of the tool that caused the failure

completedResults.description: Results collected before the failure occurred
